## Checklist

- [ ] If this changes the design, the design documents in `docs/` were updated first, in their own commit
- [ ] New behaviour has tests, and bug fixes have a test that fails without the fix
- [ ] Core doesn't refer to any specific service type or plugin; plugins use only the SDK and their declared dependencies
- [ ] No secrets, real hostnames, IP addresses or other real infrastructure details
